acceptance_predicates.description: Barrier lifecycle and SQLite coordination writes reject uncertain, stale, or unsafe state under the prescribed lock order.
Bounded multi-process, process-death, identity, lock, and transaction tests cover the admitted coordination routes.
Public upgrade apply, rollback, release, and Dispatch remain rejection-only; the model is best-effort guidance.

definition_of_done: The route inventory identifies the accepted SQLite coordination writes and their bounded evidence.
Independent review and hosted checks pass at one exact product revision.
No source-to-model refinement proof is required; unsupported public mutation remains disabled.

inputs.description: Merged barrier acquire, recheck, recovery, and reopen lifecycle evidence.
Merged SQLite authority, control-store, session, and effect route evidence.

outputs.description: An exact-head, independently reviewed, rejection-safe barrier and coordination-write audit.

gates.description: All evidence identifies one product revision.
A separate review worker passes before acceptance.
No public upgrade mutation path is enabled.
